Maria (partnerships): Heads-up: GCP marketplace will start sending signed_usage_token instead of raw usage_key next Tue 07:00 PT. Need to confirm ingestion path.

Kevin (finance): Does the token include partner_id or just a signature? We use the key to tag ledger rows.

Noor (partner-ops): Vendor says token is JWT with partner_id in the payload and a kid header. They will provide pubkeys and rotation schedule.

Sam (eng): OK. Plan: accept token, verify signature with kid->pubkey, extract partner_id, and fallback to legacy key header. Add metric `ingest.token_verification_fail`.

Noor (partner-ops): I'll request the JWKS endpoint and rotation cadence. Also ask for a one-day test window.

marketplace-bot: NOTICE: GCP marketplace signed token rollout scheduled 2026-07-14T14:00:00Z. Docs: https://marketplace.vendor/gcp/signed-tokens/3460012345

Kevin (finance): For reconciliation we need the raw kid->pubkey mapping CSV. If tokens are opaque after rotation, include a per-event partner_id claim.

Sam (eng): Action items: 1) add JWT verify + partner_id extraction (PR target: feature/jwt-ingest) 2) instrument fail metric and set alert >0.1% 3) keep legacy header as fallback.

Maria (partnerships): Great. Noor, please schedule the test window; I'll notify finance and partners.

Kevin (finance): I'll standby for the CSV so nightly reconcile can use token->partner mapping.

Sam (eng): We'll redact token in logs and only surface kid and partner_id.

Maria (partnerships): Thanks team.
